headline: Treasury yields pull back from multi-decade highs following tech sell-off
summary: Treasury yields retreated from multi-decade highs as a rout in semiconductor and technology stocks sent investors rushing into government bonds for safety.
why: US Treasury yields serve as the foundational benchmark for global borrowing costs, influencing everything from mortgage rates to corporate debt pricing.

impacts.name: US Treasuries
impacts.why: A flight to safety out of volatile equities increases demand for government bonds, driving their prices up and yields down.

why_moved: Capital fleeing the collapsing tech sector rotated into sovereign debt, overwhelming supply pressures and forcing yields lower.
